procedure.method: Independent fresh craft review of only the explicitly pinned inputs. I read the packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact addendum/method and adapter schema, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded maker/source paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts; consequently there were zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads. I then actually opened and visually inspected the exact PNGs using tools.view_image with detail original, emitting each returned image: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen image displays completed before the first deliberate copy-transcription stage or any judgment/score. My first pixel readings were retained in session memory after the fifteen-view sequence, including M4's visible spaces around its time dash; none were populated from required-copy data. No ambiguity-triggered revisit was made. Hash/byte/PNG-header checks were separate binding checks, never claims of semantic viewing. All natives are 1672x941; usage views 720x405; thumbnails 320x180. Native 16:9 acceptance uses nearest-integer-single-edge height rounding: ideal height 940.5, actual 941, error 0.5 pixel; it is not mathematically exact 16:9. No image generation/editing, peer review, fork, resume or delegated critic was used. Session identity remains null for runner binding.
